role: The animated atlas sprites: TextureAtlasSprite.updateAnimation's counters, TextureClock and TextureCompass's dials, TextureMap.updateAnimations over the blocks then items atlas, and the upload each does as a patch of a recorded or live RGBA atlas from the recording's dumped source frames (state/anim.json, anim.rgba).

structs.name: texanim_world
structs.java: what the dials read: isSurfaceWorld, getCelestialAngle(1.0F), getSpawnPoint, the player's posX/posZ/rotationYaw

gpu: texanim_load: malloc of the whole anim.rgba (load time, not the tick)
the scene cache (scene_dir, scene_anim, scene_state) and the live pointers (live_anim, live_state): static mutable state behind a mutex, for the recorded renderer and the one live client
notes: Recorded scenes: every atlas reader calls texanim_patch_scene, which applies the frame row's state; an item frame's compass moves that state on (texanim_compass_render_step) before the hand and HUD draw. Mipmapped atlases are patched at level 0 only; every recording has mipmaps off.
